prose: John Gruber highlights Windows Central's report that Microsoft has quietly retired the 'Copilot+ PC' hardware category it launched with Qualcomm in 2024 - the AI-first PC branding built around exclusive NPU features - barely two years after introducing it with fanfare. (Summary based on the Daring Fireball feed excerpt; the source pages were not fetched this pass.)
highlights: Microsoft retires the Copilot+ PC brand launched in 2024
Category defined AI-first Windows hardware with exclusive NPU features
Quiet end for a heavily marketed initiative, per Windows Central
